questions.question: People like to eat ______ on Dragon Boat Festival. They are made of rice.
questions.explanation: 端午節的代表性食物是粽子 (zongzi)。
questions.commonMisconception: 將各節慶食物混淆（如中秋節吃月餅）。

questions.question:
A: What are they doing on the river?
B: They are having a ______ boat race. It's very exciting!
questions.explanation: 端午節在河上舉行的比賽是划龍舟 (dragon boat race)。
questions.commonMisconception: 拼寫或單字辨識錯誤。

questions.question: I always ______ my teeth before I go to bed.
questions.explanation: 刷牙的動詞固定用法為 brush (brush one's teeth)。
questions.commonMisconception: 受中文「洗」牙影響誤用 wash。

questions.question:
A: ______ often do you play sports?
B: I play sports every weekend.
questions.explanation: 詢問頻率使用 How often 句型。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 every weekend 時間點誘導誤用 When。

questions.question:
A: Happy Dragon Boat Festival!
B: ______!
questions.explanation: 對方的節慶祝賀，自然回報「你也是」(You too / Same to you)。
questions.commonMisconception: 應答語不夠自然。

questions.question:
A: Does Toby always take a shower in the morning?
B: No, he ______. He takes a shower at night.
questions.explanation: 對 Does 開頭問句的否定簡答為 No, he doesn't。
questions.commonMisconception: 受 always 影響誤選 A 或格式錯誤。

questions.question: It's usually very ______ in Taiwan during the Dragon Boat Festival.
questions.explanation: 端午節通常在六月，台灣的天氣此時通常很熱 (hot)。
questions.commonMisconception: 氣候與節期感測力弱。

questions.question: We ______ red envelopes (紅包) last Chinese New Year.
questions.explanation: 描述過去的節慶活動，使用過去式 got。
questions.commonMisconception: 時態未對應時間點。

questions.question: The dragon boat race is ______ June this year.
questions.explanation: 在某月份，介係詞使用 in。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 on (特定日期) 與 in (月份/年份)。

questions.question:
Ken: 'I love zongzi because they are yummy.' 
Leo: 'I like moon cakes more. They are sweet.' 
Question: Which festival does Leo like?
questions.explanation: 喜歡月餅 (moon cakes) 暗示他喜歡中秋節 (Moon Festival)。
questions.commonMisconception: 食物與節慶的關聯推理漏洞。

questions.question:
I usually read books on Saturdays. I often play soccer on Sundays. 
Question: What do I DO on weekends?
questions.explanation: 整合週六與週日的活動即為週末活動。
questions.commonMisconception: 資訊提取不全。

questions.question:
On Dragon Boat Festival at noon (中午), people try to make an egg ______ on the floor. 
Question: What do people do with the egg?
questions.explanation: 端午節正午「立蛋」是著名的傳統習俗 (stand an egg up)。
questions.commonMisconception: 不具備在地節度習俗的英文化連結。

questions.question:
Lily gets up at 6:30. Sam gets up at 7:00. Ken gets up at 7:30.
Question: Who gets up the EARLIEST?
questions.explanation: 6:30 是當中最的時間，故由 Lily 最早起 (earliest)。
questions.commonMisconception: 最高級詞彙理解與時間比較能力的落差。

questions.question:
People often hang (掛) sachets (香包) on their necks during Dragon Boat Festival. They ______ good.
Question: Choose the best verb.
questions.explanation: 香包的功能是發散香氣，對應動詞為 smell。
questions.commonMisconception: 感官動詞誤用。

questions.question: My father ______ late for work. He is always on time.
questions.explanation: 頻率副詞放在 B 動詞之後。且後方說準時 (on time)，故應為「從不」遲到。
questions.commonMisconception: 頻率副詞位置與語意邏輯雙重判斷錯誤。

questions.question: Wait! The water is too ______ to swim in. Let's watch from the side.
questions.explanation: 「水太...以至於不能下水游泳」最合理的環境限制是水太深 (deep)。
questions.commonMisconception: 缺乏環境安全意識與詞彙連結。

questions.question: If you want to win the dragon boat race, you ______ exercise and be strong.
questions.explanation: 給予建立優勢的建議，使用情態助動詞 should。
questions.commonMisconception: 助動詞語意誤判。

questions.question: In Western culture, people find hidden (隱藏的) ______ on Easter Day.
questions.explanation: 復活節 (Easter) 的傳統是彩蛋 (eggs)，需與端午節立蛋區分。
questions.commonMisconception: 節慶文化對應錯誤。

questions.question: Typical (典型的) breakfasts in Taiwan include soy milk and fan-tuan. They ______ delicious.
questions.explanation: 主詞 They 指代早餐品項（複數），用 B 動詞 are 修飾形容詞 delicious。
questions.commonMisconception: 受單項 food 概念影響誤選 is 或受 tastes 誤導（在此為形容詞 delicious，tastes 後也常用形容詞但主謂需一致）。

questions.question:
Today is June 20th. Dragon Boat Festival is June 22nd.
Question: Is it Dragon Boat Festival the day after tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 20 號的後天 (day after tomorrow) 是 22 號，正確。
questions.commonMisconception: 時間推算短路。
